当前使用 just_audio / media_kit，没有独占与 DSP 能力: Using just_audio / media_kit; exclusive output and DSP are unavailable.
把每声道延时、低通后混入对侧，减轻耳机里\"声音在脑中\"的感觉: Delays and low-passes each channel before mixing it into the opposite ear, reducing the "sound in your head" effect.
按 EBU R128 目标测量并归一（本引擎未实现测量）: Measure and normalize to the EBU R128 target (this engine does not implement measurement).
按设备能力自动选择：原生 DSD → DoP → PCM，逐级回退: Pick by device capability: Native DSD → DoP → PCM, falling back step by step.
更小的缓冲换更低延迟，更大的缓冲更容易在负载下不断流: Smaller buffers lower latency; larger buffers keep playback from dropping out under load.
样本峰值上限 −1 dBFS，防止 EQ 提升导致削波: Sample peak ceiling at −1 dBFS prevents clipping from EQ boosts.
独占 · 同采样率替代格式: Exclusive · alternate format at the same rate
独占模式请求设备不再与系统混音共用；实际是否独占以引擎报告的会话格式为准: Exclusive mode asks the device to stop sharing the mix with the system; the engine's reported session format is the actual result.
要求 ALSA 原生 DSD 字格式，仅 Linux hw: 直连可用: Requires ALSA's native DSD word format; only direct Linux hw: connections support it.
要求精确的 24-bit DoP 载波；设备不接受时拒绝播放，不回退: Requires an exact 24-bit DoP carrier; playback is refused rather than falling back when the device cannot accept it.
要求设备接受与源完全相同的整数格式；不满足时打开会失败，而不是悄悄转成 PCM: Requires the device to accept the source's exact integer format; opening fails instead of silently converting to PCM.
解码后的整数样本直接送设备，同时旁路软件音量与 EQ: Decoded integer samples go straight to the device, bypassing software volume and EQ.
该平台不支持独占输出: Exclusive output is not supported on this platform.
软件音量必须为 100%：Bit-perfect 会绕过音量与 EQ，引擎会以此: Software volume must be 100%: Bit-perfect bypasses volume and EQ, and the engine refuses direct output otherwise.
选择预设会自动启用均衡器: Choosing a preset turns on the equalizer.
